They do not cover a flight from London (outside the EU) to Budapest (inside the EU), so I can't confirm whether it is free. Guide dogs are allowed on board, but you must tell Wizz Air when booking and send your certificate and required travel documents to specialassistance@wizzair.com or the Special Assistance Call Centre no later than 48 hours before departure. The General Conditions of Carriage refer to Recognised Assistance Dogs in paragraph 8.4, which is not included here. Please check with Wizz Air for the charge on this route.
